description: Post to the user's Discord server. Free. With the Hermoso bot added it posts as the bot to channel (or the brand's default channel) with attachments up to 25 MB a message, replyTo, threadId (inside a thread), startThread (a thread under the post) and threadName (a forum channel); the messageId it returns ("<channel>/<message>") is what edit, delete and get_discord_message take. Without the bot it posts through the brand's announcement webhook (never the alert one): ≤2000 characters, files up to 20 MB attached (up to 10), larger ones as links. Mentions never ping unless mentions:true. EITHER WAY it can carry embeds (up to 10 rich cards, 6000 characters between them), a native poll (question, up to 10 answers, 1 to 768 hours; get_discord_poll reads the votes) and tts (read aloud). A webhook post can also take a display name and avatar for that one post (username, avatarUrl); crosspost:true (bot only) also publishes the post to every server that follows the announcement channel. Anything over a Discord limit is refused, never cut. Reactions are the only per-post number (get_discord_message). Not connected: connect_connector with provider discord and no fields returns the install link.

allowDuplicate.description: post it even though an identical post was just made

avatarUrl.description: webhook posts only: an avatar image link for this one post

brand.description: WHICH PROFILE this post belongs to — id or exact name from list_brands (a shared workspace: its profile id). Beats the connection's pin for THIS CALL ONLY; a name that matches no profile, or two, is REFUSED and nothing is posted.

channel.description: HERMOSO BOT: channel id or #name (list_discord_channels); unset = the default channel

crosspost.description: HERMOSO BOT, announcement channels: also publish it to every server that follows the channel (cannot be undone)

discordServer.description: HERMOSO BOT: which Discord server (id or name) when the bot is in several

embeds.description: up to 10 embeds: { title (256), description (4096), url, color ("#5865F2" or a number), fields: [{ name (256), value (1024), inline }] (25), author: { name (256), url, iconUrl }, footer: { text (2048), iconUrl }, image, thumbnail (links), timestamp (ISO or "now") }

hook.description: the post's angle — a list_hooks id or your own wording, reused exactly

ideaId.description: short id of the content-plan idea this post came from

idempotencyKey.description: any stable string: a repeat within 24h returns the original post instead of posting again

imageUrls.description: up to 10 files in one message

mentions.description: let @everyone / @here / role mentions ping people (off by default)

poll.description: a native poll: { question (300), answers: ["..", { text (55), emoji }] (up to 10), durationHours (1-768, default 24), multiselect }. A poll cannot be edited after posting

recipe.description: the post's FORMAT id, e.g. "slideshow" or "imessage_chat" — post_performance groups by it, so reuse one id per format

replyTo.description: HERMOSO BOT: reply to this message id

startThread.description: HERMOSO BOT: start a thread under the new post with this title

threadId.description: HERMOSO BOT: post inside this existing thread

threadName.description: required when the channel is a FORUM channel: the new thread title

tts.description: a text-to-speech message, read aloud to people who have the channel open

username.description: webhook posts only: a different display name than the webhook's own

name: post_to_discord
title: Post a Discord announcement
